text:
zara: late-night movie recs wanted — 90–120m, mellow vibes, not a tearjerker. bonus if the soundtrack is worth putting on repeat. any faves? :crescent_moon:
aj: The Nice Guys — dumb fun, upbeat 70s/80s tunes. light, funny, 2hrish. perfect for late-night distractions. :popcorn:
kevin: Only Lovers Left Alive — slow, stylish, and the score (Jarmusch/Tom Waits vibes) is amazing if you want mood music after the credits. not a romcom :)
marie: if you want something musical and gentle: Once (the original) — intimate, acoustic soundtrack. shorter runtime too. great for unwinding.
samir: for chill + weird: The Double Life of Veronique — haunting score, dreamy. might be a little heavy but very listenable after watching.
az: not sure if anyone's into silly picks, but Shaun of the Dead has a great soundtrack and is actually comforting at night.
zara: these are great — thanks! anyone want to vote on which to watch tonight? react with emoji:
• :one: The Nice Guys
• :two: Only Lovers Left Alive
• :three: Once
• :four: The Double Life of Veronique
• :five: Shaun of the Dead
aj: voting :one:
kevin: voting :two: (would also recommend listening to the score on repeat)
marie: :three: because acoustic comfort
spotify-bot: Playlist for tonight's thread compiled: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7example (contains tracks from Once, Only Lovers, and some retro 70s vibes)
zara: ok looks like we landed on The Nice Guys (:one: wins). soundtrack queued — thanks all. next time bring book recs to pair with the film! :movie_camera:
